decision.next: the gate rejected 1-7 layers: the result is a hybrid with 8-N attention layers, NOT attention-free, so it can never be the Q9-AF backbone (heads.backbone.q9af_from_stock refuses it). It is reported as 'Q9-H<8-N>' with the same quality / retrieval / Index numbers (non-binding for Q9-AF) and the curve; the m2 backbone defaults to RWKV7 (attention-free); shipping the hybrid is decision-needed for the user; no re-conversion of rejected layers without a new spend issue and a new pre-registered rule

gate._comment: The 511e8dd enforced gate, unchanged; n_windows 32 as shipped and run in job-5cmat (PR #73, a non-directional precision change disclosed there). Enforced in-run by convert.progressive (policy enforce: a failing layer is rolled back to attention and the loop continues with the next layer). decide_full8 re-computes every step's verdict from its recorded gate numbers and these constants; a mismatch is no-measurement.

quality._comment: 511e8dd success_rule bounds. Only the ppl bound is rescaled to 8 layers, because only for perplexity does pre-existing plan text give an 8-layer budget: the gate's cumulative dNLL budget 0.15 (vs teacher, wikitext-103 validation) bounds the same quantity that the held-out ppl ratio measures (wikitext-2 test), so ppl_ratio_max = exp(max_cum_delta_nll) = exp(0.15) = 1.16183, rounded DOWN to 1.1618. The 511e8dd one-layer bound 1.02 is the per-layer share of that budget (ln 1.02 = 0.0198 ~ 0.15 / 8 = 0.0188); keeping 1.02 for 8 layers would make the plan's own cumulative budget unreachable (any model the gate accepts with cumulative dNLL > 0.02 would fail). MMLU and Index have no 8-layer scaling in any plan text, so their 511e8dd bounds apply unchanged (stricter for 8 layers than for 1).

mmlu_source._comment: A1: full MMLU test set, cais/mmlu all/test (pinned revision c30699e8), 14,042 items, same prompt and letter-logit scoring as probes.core.mmlu, both arms in the same job on the same code path. drop = 100 x (acc_stock - acc_final). Each arm must report n == 14042, the same items_sha256, and per-item correctness; the stock arm runs with no student layer and the final arm with exactly the converted layers.

ci.method: paired per-item bootstrap of the accuracy difference

retrieval._comment: 511e8dd bounds, unchanged (no 8-layer scaling exists in the plan).
